name: Fit IVIM
summary: Fits the intravoxel incoherent motion (IVIM) model to DWI with DIPY dipy_fit_ivim 1.1.1 and outputs maps of predicted S0, perfusion fraction, pseudo-diffusion D* and diffusion D.
description: Runs DIPY's dipy_fit_ivim workflow on the DWI with its bvals, bvecs and brain mask. IVIM needs multiple low b-values (below a few hundred s/mm^2) to separate perfusion from diffusion; it is not meaningful for single-shell high-b data. Note that this version of main passes the b0_threshold value to --split_b_D and --split_b_S0, so those two parameters are not used.

inputs.description: Diffusion-weighted image with bvals and bvecs.
inputs.requirements: Should include several low b-values for the IVIM bi-exponential fit.

inputs.description: Brain mask in DWI space restricting the fit.

outputs.description:
- S0_predicted.nii.gz: Name of the S0 signal estimated to be saved
- perfusion_fraction.nii.gz: Name of the estimated volume fractions to be saved
- D_star.nii.gz: Name of the estimated pseudo-diffusion parameter to be saved
- D.nii.gz: Name of the estimated diffusion parameter to be saved

parameters.description: Value to split the bvals to estimate D for the two-stage process of fitting
Value to split the bvals to estimate S0 for the two-stage process of fitting.
Threshold value for the b0 bval.
DIPY workflow to run; only dipy_fit_ivim is accepted.
